---
title: "About me"
---

I'm Jose Lanuza, a community ecologist studying biodiversity through ecological interactions, particularly plant–pollinator networks.

My research combines field ecology, ecological modelling and quantitative analysis to investigate how ecological communities are structured and respond to environmental change.

## Academic background

I am currently a postdoctoral researcher at IMEDEA (UIB-CSIC), Mallorca, Spain. This section can be updated whenever my affiliation changes.
